commands.review_summary:
The PR adds Android canvas URL normalization, WebViewClient main-frame loopback blocking, and regression tests for loopback, malformed, remote, and bundled canvas URLs.

PR surface: Other +212. Total +212 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection shows current main stores any nonblank canvas.navigate URL and passes it to WebView.loadUrl, while CanvasScreen has no main-frame URL override filter; I did not run a current-main Android device repro in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(android): block loopback canvas navigation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an Android canvas navigation gap where a gateway-controlled `canvas.navigate` URL could load loopback services on the Android device, including through WebView-compatible URL forms or main-frame redirects.

## Why This Change Was Made

Android now normalizes canvas navigation targets before loading them and falls back to the bundled canvas for loopback or malformed `http(s)` targets whose host cannot be safely extracted. The Canvas WebViewClient applies the same check to main-frame navigations and redirects so remote pages cannot redirect the canvas into device-local services.

## User Impact

Android users keep normal remote canvas pages and bundled file canvases, while local-device loopback services are no longer reachable through the canvas surface. This does not add settings, migrations, release-flow changes, or provider behavior changes.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `cd apps/android; JAVA_HOME="F:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" ANDROID_HOME="F:\Android\Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="F:\Android\Sdk" .\gradlew.bat testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.node.CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest`
- `cd apps/android; JAVA_HOME="F:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" ANDROID_HOME="F:\Android\Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="F:\Android\Sdk" .\gradlew.bat testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.node.CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest`
- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local --base origin/main`

### Live proof (local Android emulator)

Environment: Windows, Android Studio JBR, AVD `Medium_Phone` (API 17), `emulator-5554`.

Unit: `CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL

Device (debug APK + local debug `canvasProof` injector, not part of PR diff):

| Case | Input URL | Blocked | Load |
|---|---|---|---|
| loopback | `http://127.0.0.1:18789` | yes | bundled scaffold |
| remote | `https://example.com/canvas` | no | remote URL kept |

Logcat: `CanvasE2E PASS` with both cases; loopback resolves to scaffold, remote keeps `https://example.com/canvas`.

Repro: `scripts/repro/android-canvas-loopback-live-proof.ps1` (local). Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99874#issuecomment-4886660954
